description:

Get Logistics, a national FTL provider for shippers and freight forwarders, is seeking a motivated and experienced individual for the position of Carrier Representative. As a part of our dynamic team, your primary responsibility will be to develop and maintain strong business relationships with carriers, ensuring the smooth movement of shipments throughout the supply chain.
At Get Logistics, we strive to not just provide transportation solutions, but to add value to our clients' supply chains. • Collaborate with sales and operations teams to analyze freight trends and carrier performance to continuously improve our service offerings.

• Keep up-to-date with market trends and regulatory changes affecting FTL transportation.

• Ensure compliance with all company and regulatory requirements.

• At least 5 years of experience in freight brokerage or a similar role, with a specific focus on FTL.

title: Database Product Architect (IT Technical Lead)
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe. Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Database Platform Architect to design, implement, and maintain robust and scalable database solutions for Jabil 's global operations. This role is crucial in ensuring the performance, security, and reliability of our critical data infrastructure.

Job Responsibilities

* Lead the architectural design and evolution of Jabil 's database platforms, including relational, NoSQL, and data warehousing technologies.
* Define and enforce database standards, best practices, and governance policies across the organization.
* Evaluate and recommend new database technologies and tools to meet evolving business needs and optimize performance.
* Collaborate with development teams, system administrators, and other architects to integrate database solutions seamlessly into Jabil 's IT ecosystem.
* Perform capacity planning, performance tuning, and optimization of database environments.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for database architecture, design, and operational procedures.
* Provide expert guidance and mentorship to database administrators and developers on complex database issues.
* Ensure compliance with data security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex database-related issues, providing root cause analysis and implementing preventative measures.

Job Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in database architecture, design, and administration, with a strong focus on large-scale enterprise environments.
* Deep expertise in various database technologies, including but not limited to Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, or similar.
* Proven experience with cloud-based database services (e.g., AWS RDS, Azure SQL Database) and cloud native database architectures.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, schema design, and database normalization/denormalization techniques.
* Experience with database performance tuning, optimization, and monitoring tools.
* Familiarity with data warehousing concepts, ETL processes, and business intelligence platforms.
* Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for database automation.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, global environment.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate) are a plus.
*Fluent English level is a must.

What We Offer
The opportunity to set the technical direction for a global database platform.
Genuine design authority - your approval is the gate, not a recommendation.
A key role in database modernization, automation, and cloud transformation initiatives.
Collaboration with experienced platform, application, security, and business teams.
A high-impact position with broad visibility across the organization.

You will move between mechanical design, electrical integration, prototyping, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting, working alongside engineers and scientists to turn lab needs into reliable engineering systems.

Your work will support the next generation of lab automation at Lila, helping improve the reliability, scalability, and performance of systems used across our scientific programs. You will leave the term with practical experience across the full mechatronics stack, from concept and CAD through build, test, and iteration.

What You'll Be Building

• Design and build mechanical and electromechanical components for automated lab systems.

• Support integration of sensors, actuators, motion systems, and control hardware.

• Create CAD models, drawings, prototypes, fixtures, and test setups.

• Assemble, debug, and iterate on hardware for workcells and custom instrumentation.

• Run tests, document results, and communicate design changes clearly.

• Collaborate with engineers and scientists to translate lab workflows into reliable systems.

• Contribute to improvements that increase system reliability, usability, and maintainability.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Currently pursuing a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field.

• Experience with CAD design, prototyping, fabrication, or hands-on engineering projects.

• Foundational understanding of mechanical systems, electrical systems, sensors, actuators, or controls.

• Comfortable building, testing, debugging, and documenting physical systems.

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail in hands-on technical work.

• Clear communication skills and ability to collaborate across engineering and scientific teams.

• Curiosity about lab automation, instrumentation, robotics, or autonomous science.

Bonus Points For

• Experience with SolidWorks or another parametric CAD tool.

• Exposure to electrical wiring, instrumentation, controls, or data acquisition systems.

• Experience with robotics, lab automation, industrial automation, or motion systems.

• Familiarity with 3D printing, machining, sheet metal, or rapid prototyping methods.

• Previous internship, co-op, lab, project team, or R&D experience.

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

ABOUT OPTEXITY

Optexity is a product-driven research lab building clinical reasoning and computer use models on data no other lab can reach. We deploy directly inside clinics and hospitals - including systems with no APIs, using integration infrastructure we've built and open-sourced - and in return become their preferred partner. That gives us proprietary clinical reasoning trajectories from practicing physicians, and a feedback loop between real patient encounters, our models, and the products built on top of them.

We're a small, fast-moving founding team with multiple published papers in NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR etc and background from Apple, Amazon, Microsoft, CMU, IIT.

We are backed by world-class investors and leaders like Jeff Dean, Neotribe VC, PearVC, Together Fund and Zapier Fund.

 

HOW WE WORK

- Customer obsession - we start with the customer and work backwards

- Intellectual honesty - ideas matter more than titles; we communicate directly and assume good intent, even in disagreement

- Bias for action - we build and learn with customers rather than debate in the abstract

- Extreme ownership - we own outcomes, not just tasks, and see problems through

About the role

This is not a support role, and not a sales role. It is a flexible, hands-on role for someone who wants to start a company one day. You will be the face of Optexity to our customers: the practices, clinics and doctors who use our product every day. You will sit with them on site, learn how they work, and bring what you learn back to the founders to shape the product. In one role you get product, customer discovery, customer success, customer coordination and a taste of engineering.

This role is on site in New York, where all of our customers are.

What you’ll do

- Work directly with doctors, practice managers and clinic staff to understand their workflows and pain points

- Run customer discovery: gather requirements, spot patterns across practices, and turn them into clear product priorities

- Help design the product with the founders and engineers, and test new features with customers

- Onboard new practices: coordinate setup, access, integrations and training

- Drive usage: track adoption, find out why users stall, and get more doctors using the product more often

- Be the single point of contact for customers, and close the loop on every issue and request

- Work with engineers to debug problems, write specs, and ship small fixes yourself where you can

- Help with early sales and renewals by building trust and relationships with practices

Ideal candidate

- Genuinely wants to start a company someday and wants a front-row seat

- Strong communicator who is comfortable talking with doctors and busy clinic staff

- Highly organized, follows through, and closes loops

- Energized by ambiguity and takes ownership without needing to be guided

- Based in New York, or willing to move, and comfortable being on site with customers most days

- Comfortable with technology, and curious about how software gets built

- New Grads welcome to apply

Nice to have

- Prior experience in customer success, consulting, startups, product or operations

- Familiarity with healthcare, practice operations or EMR systems

- Basic technical skills such as SQL, scripting or working with APIs

- Prior founder or founding team experience

What you get

- Direct, daily work with the founders, plus exposure to board and investor conversations

- A broad view of product, customers, sales and engineering that few roles offer

- Real ownership, with scope that grows as the company does

- Support on your path to starting your own company

- Competitive salary

Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

The Role

As the Senior Benefits Program Manager for Asia-Pacific and Japan (APJ), you will lead the regional design, strategy, and compliance of our benefit and wellness programs across 10+ countries, with a primary focus on India. Reporting to the Head of Global Benefits, you will navigate an evolving legislative landscape-including India’s Labor Codes and APJ statutory updates-to build scalable, competitive rewards. You will balance long-term strategic planning with operational excellence, serving as our regional subject matter expert to support international business growth.

What You’ll Do

• Regional Strategy & Legislative Governance: Lead end-to-end program design, evaluation, and statutory compliance across APJ, proactively translating complex regional legislative changes (e.g., India Labor Codes, data privacy, statutory leave, and pension updates) into risk-mitigated benefit policies.

• Benefits Renewals & Financial Partnership: Manage the full lifecycle of benefit program renewals across the region, partnering efficiently with Finance and Procurement on budgeting, contract execution, purchase orders, and monthly invoice processing/reconciliation.

• Shared Services & Operations Transition: Drive the operational transition of benefits processes from the Center of Excellence (COE) to Global Shared Services, establishing clear documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and training programs for HR Operations to seamlessly take over day-to-day administration.

• Vendor & Financial Optimization: Own regional broker relationships, execute complex multi-country RFPs and contract negotiations, and lead long-term financial modeling, budgeting, and cost-impact analyses for health, welfare, and retirement plans.

• Process & Technology Architecture: Partner with HRIT, Payroll, and Finance to design, automate, and scale benefits administration workflows within Workday and local benefit platforms across the APJ region.

• Cross-Functional Executive Leadership: Formulate and present executive-level business cases and strategic benefit proposals to senior leadership, while serving as the primary escalation point for complex employee inquiries.

What You’ll Bring

• APJ Benefits & Statutory Expertise: Demonstrated experience owning and executing multi-country employee benefit programs across the Asia-Pacific and Japan region, including direct experience navigating India’s statutory compliance frameworks, retirement schemes, and health/risk benefits.

• Strategic Vendor & RFP Management: Proven experience managing regional broker relationships, leading end-to-end RFP processes, and negotiating multi-country vendor contracts and service level agreements.

• HR Systems & Operational Automation: Hands-on experience scaling benefits administration through enterprise HRIS (such as Workday) or local benefit administration tools, including building automated workflows and data controls.

• Executive Communication & Influence: Experience building data-driven business cases, presenting strategic rewards proposals to senior executive stakeholders, and partnering with cross-functional partners in Legal, Payroll, and Finance.

We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, work travel, or other approved leave.

title: CX Support Agent - Level 1
description:
CX Support Agent - Level 1

Join a growing SaaS support team helping mission-driven organizations get more value from the software they use every day.

This is a remote, Philippines-based Level 1 customer support role for a software company serving nonprofits, hospitals, governments, and other volunteer-powered organizations. You will be the first human support layer after AI-assisted triage, helping customers resolve practical software questions through chat, email, phone, and screen-sharing support.

The best fit is patient, detail-oriented, fluent in professional English, comfortable learning new software quickly, and energized by helping users who may not be deeply technical.

What You Will Do

• Monitor and manage Level 1 support requests during your assigned coverage hours.

• Respond to customer questions through chat, email, phone, and screen-sharing sessions.

• Troubleshoot software, account, workflow, and usage-related questions.

• Help customers understand how to use the product in clear, simple language.

• Escalate complex issues to Level 2, product, data, or technical teams when needed.

• Process account changes, upgrades, downgrades, and general company inquiries when assigned.

• Maintain clear, empathetic, and accurate written communication.

• Stay engaged during the shift and contribute to team check-ins, handoffs, and support coverage.

What We Are Looking For

• Full professional English fluency, both written and verbal.

• Prior customer support, help desk, BPO, SaaS, software, or technical support experience.

• Strong written communication with excellent grammar, clarity, and attention to detail.

• Patience and empathy when supporting users with different levels of technical confidence.

• Ability to simplify software questions and explain steps clearly.

• Comfort working with support tools such as Intercom, HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshdesk, or similar systems.

• Strong organization, time management, follow-through, and prioritization.

• Ability to work independently from home while staying active in team communication.

• Reliable remote-work setup and stable internet.

Nice To Have

• Experience supporting SaaS or software products.

• Experience with Intercom or HubSpot.

• Experience supporting nonprofit, volunteer-management, CRM, scheduling, training, communications, or compliance software.

• Experience using metrics such as response time, resolution quality, customer satisfaction, ticket volume, or escalation rate.

• Prior remote work experience with North American, UK, European, or Australian customers.

Schedule

There are two openings. Candidates must be based in the Philippines and able to work one of these remote schedules:

• EMEA shift: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM UTC, which is 5:00 PM to 1:00 AM PHT.

• AMER shift: 5:00 PM to 1:00 AM UTC, which is 1:00 AM to 9:00 AM PHT.

Contracted hours follow UTC and do not change for local daylight savings time.

Compensation

USD $1,000 to $1,300 per month, based on experience and fit.

Why This Role

This is a chance to join a growing global support function at an important moment. The company is building a stronger Level 1 and Level 2 support model, and strong performers may have opportunities to grow as the team scales.

You will support customers doing meaningful work in their communities, and your work will directly affect whether they can use their systems confidently and efficiently.

Interview Process

Qualified candidates will complete a video interview with Urrly . The strongest candidates may also complete a practical assessment focused on written communication, attention to detail, and customer-support judgment.

Apply now and get a response within 24 hours.

title: Field Product Quality Engineer - Altius
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Field Product Quality Engineering team operates at the intersection of flight operations and mission success for Anduril’s autonomous aerial systems. We ensure that every anomaly, failure, and performance trend is captured in real time and driven to root cause resolution-so that each flight makes the next one more reliable.

This is a field-forward role. You will be on-site at launch and recovery locations, working shoulder-to-shoulder with flight crews, systems engineers, and program leadership to close the loop between what happens in the air and what gets fixed on the ground.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Flight Operations Quality Data Collection

• Work under minimal supervision with responsibilities for test planning, execution, reporting, and evaluation of the aircraft system under test (software and/or hardware).

• Manage all field configuration changes-hardware, software, and as-shipped main box contents. Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, Mission Performance, Design, Software, and Configuration Management to maintain clear as-built records in support of root cause corrective actions and customer complaints.

• Develop and maintain standardized field data collection protocols, checklists, and digital forms that ensure consistent, high-fidelity quality records across all flight events and operational sites.

• Perform real-time quality observation during launch sequences, in-flight operations, and post-flight recovery-identifying workmanship issues, procedural deviations, configuration discrepancies, and environmental factors that may affect flight performance or vehicle integrity.

• Establish, track, and analyze key quality metrics-first-flight success rate, recurring anomaly trends, pre-flight escape rate, and mean time between failures-to provide the product team with actionable reliability data.

Flight Failure Investigation & Corrective Action

• Own the end-to-end coordination of all flight failures-from initial data collection and evidence preservation through root cause analysis, corrective action implementation, and effectiveness verification. Initiate rapid “In the Field” 8D analysis to establish quick wins that enable return to flight.

• Lead cross-functional failure review boards with flight operations, systems engineering, manufacturing, and reliability engineering to determine root cause using structured methodologies (8D, 5-Why, Fishbone, Fault Tree Analysis).

• Coordinate rapid containment actions following flight anomalies, including fleet-wide inspections, hold/release decisions, and risk assessments to determine return-to-flight readiness.

• Monitor a flight failure tracking system with full traceability from symptom to root cause to corrective action closure; generate trend reports and lessons-learned summaries for program leadership.

• Interface with design engineering and upstream manufacturing/supplier quality to translate field failure findings into actionable design changes, drawing updates, supplier corrective actions (SCARs), and process improvements that prevent recurrence across the fleet.

Product Quality & Continuous Improvement

• Support Material Review Board (MRB) activities for field-discovered nonconformances, providing disposition recommendations inf

• Direct impact on the development and expansion of RSAA's SOC services.

• Work with a diverse range of organizations across different industries.

• Collaborative and remote-first working environment.

title: Transplant Coordinator
description:
HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT
At LifeNet Health , as the Transplant Coordinator , you will make an impact by leveraging your expertise, collaboration, and commitment to excellence to help advance our mission of Saving Lives, Restoring Health, and Giving Hope. Through your daily work, you will contribute to innovative solutions, operational excellence, and meaningful outcomes that support donors, patients, healthcare providers, and our communities. Whether driving strategic initiatives, improving processes, supporting customers, advancing research, developing talent, or ensuring quality and compliance, your contributions will help strengthen our ability to transform lives and shape the future of regenerative medicine.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
The role evaluates organ and tissue donor referrals for suitability in accordance with LNH, OPTN/UNOS, AOPO, CDC, and other regulatory guidelines, ensuring timely and efficient organ allocation and maximizing donor utilization. It conducts comprehensive donor assessments, including medical and social history review, hemodynamic evaluation, and physiological management to optimize organ function, while recognizing brain-death sequelae and identifying risk factors. The position also manages the full donation process by preserving organs and tissues to national standards, coordinating logistics and communication with transplant centers and hospital teams, supporting next-of-kin with sensitivity during donation decisions, and completing accurate and timely donor EMR documentation. Additionally, it provides training and mentorship by modeling advanced clinical practice, guiding new staff in competencies, and demonstrating strong leadership, communication, ethical decision-making, and critical-thinking skills.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

• 2 years critical care experience in either Medical, Surgical Trauma, Thoracic Cardiovascular, Cardiac, Pediatric or ER

• 2 years clinical experience as a RN

• Valid Driver's License

title: Admissions Writing Coach / Essay Editor
description:
About Jack Westin

Jack Westin is a leading Medical College Admissions Test (MCAT) preparation company which is known for crafting high quality, but free, practice materials. The MCAT tests students on the scientific reasoning skills and scientific knowledge which can be learned during typical undergraduate coursework.

Our Three Principles

As we continue to grow and help students, we are guided by three major principles that we believe are vital to our community.

Attention to quality

We only create courses and practice questions that we would use. That means having the best, first-class teaching content that can possibly exist. We're not satisfied with mediocrity. We don't care about the amount of time or money it takes to get something done right. If it's not perfect, we won't stop until we believe it is. This ethos runs deep within our company.

Excellence in support

We're obsessed with our students. Their well-being and success drives us each day. Great customer service is not an afterthought. It is the most important service we can offer. We understand that our students come from different learning backgrounds. It's our mission to ensure that each one has an amazing experience.

Learn from anywhere at anytime

We are committed to building the future of education on the internet so that it is easily accessible to all students from around the world. Our dedication is to all students who want to learn, regardless of their pace, and no matter what time of the day it is.

Admissions Writing Coach / Essay Editor(Remote, Part-Time)

The Admissions Writing Coach is the first expert to work with each student's application materials, helping them turn ordinary drafts into compelling, admissions-committee-ready essays. This role goes well beyond proofreading: coaches strengthen prompt alignment, content, structure, and language while keeping every essay unmistakably the student's own. Coaches work closely with Jack Westin 's admissions experts, who hold final say and conduct the last round of review before each submission returns to the student.

Responsibilities

• Coach students through personal statements, AMCAS/AACOMAS/TMDSAS activities, most meaningful experiences, secondary essays, MD/PhD essays, letters of intent, and other admissions materials

• Provide detailed, substantive feedback on prompt alignment, content, structure, and language, the way a thoughtful admissions committee member would

• Model strong writing without writing for the student: draft illustrative examples tailored to the student's real background, then guide them to rewrite in their own words

• Research relevant details (programs, diagnoses, clinical settings) so guidance and examples are specific and grounded

• Leave a small number of focused margin notes that explain your reasoning and point the student toward their next step

• Protect the student's authentic voice at every stage of the process

• Lead brainstorming and strategy sessions with students, while the assigned admissions expert remains their primary point of contact

• Flag anything needing expert judgment with clear, actionable notes, and document your reasoning so guidance stays consistent across the team

• Contribute to educational resources, training materials, and admissions content, and participate in coach training and quality reviews

• Meet established turnaround times and quality benchmarks

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Creative Writing, English, Journalism, Communications, or a related field (Premium Admissions Level)

• At least 5 years of professional editing, writing, teaching, publishing, or journalism experience and/or a creative writing certification (Signature Admissions Level)

• Exceptional writing, developmental feedback, and coaching skills, with strong command of grammar, style, and mechanics

• Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines

• Experience coaching or editing medical school admissions materials preferred

• Familiarity with AMC

title: Product Manager | Bill Pay
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE 

Every business pays bills, and many of them still do it by hand. Someone opens the invoice, types it in, codes it, chases approvals, pays it, matches it and syncs it to the books. It's one of the largest manual workflows left in finance.

We're building the version where software does that work. Bills come in and get read, coded, matched, approved and paid, and a person steps in only when judgment matters. Bill Pay is already one of Ramp's fastest-growing products. The next few years decide who owns AP for the next decade, and we plan for it to be us.

We're looking for a PM who wants to build that.

- Please note that this role requires in-person presence at our NYC or SF office at least 2 days/week.

- Level will be determined based on the candidate’s interview performance and previous scope of responsibility.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own strategy, roadmap and results for a major part of Bill Pay.

- Spend real time with AP clerks, controllers and CFOs, and turn what you see into product.

- Prototype with customers, set quality bars with Engineering and Data, and ship automation people trust.

- Measure success by adoption, automation and time saved, then use the data to decide what comes next.

- Work with Procurement, Accounting, Payments and Risk so a bill moves from inbox to payment to the books without gaps.

PROBLEMS YOU'LL WORK ON

- How do we get from "AI drafts the bill" to "AI handles the bill" without customers losing trust or control?

- When should an agent act on its own, when should it ask, and how do we show our work so a controller signs off with confidence?

- How do we make one product that a 10-person startup sets up in minutes and a multi-entity enterprise with an ERP and an AP team runs at scale?

- How do we catch the wrong bill, the duplicate and the suspicious vendor change before the money leaves?

- How do we use what Ramp knows across millions of transactions to help customers pay smarter, not just faster?

WHAT YOU NEED

- You have 5+ years building products, and you've owned at least one from first customer conversation to real adoption.

- You've built with AI hands-on, whether in products, prototypes or side projects, and you have opinions about evals, failure modes and user control.

- You're technical enough to go deep with engineers on data models and integrations, and you pull your own data.

- You can make complex workflows simple without stripping out what power users need.

- You learn new domains fast. You don't need to know AP today, but you'll want to know it better than anyone in six months.

- You write clearly, decide quickly and get teams to ship.

- You want a hard problem, a high bar and more scope as soon as you've earned it.

NICE-TO-HAVES

- You've worked on AP, payments, accounting or other finance software.

- You've shipped AI to production, especially document understanding or agent workflows.

- You've built for enterprise customers: ERPs, multi-entity setups, complex approvals and permissions.

- You've worked at a high-growth start

title: Elektriker (m/w/d)

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Chipindustrie - von Anfang an!

Deine Rolle bei Black Semiconductor

Bei Black Semiconductor entwickeln wir eine neue Generation der Halbleitertechnologie. Mit unserer ersten Produktionsanlage FabOne in Aachen schaffen wir die Grundlage für die Chipfertigung der Zukunft.

Dafür suchen wir dich! Als Elektriker*in wirst du Teil unseres Facility-Teams und unterstützt den Aufbau, die Inbetriebnahme und den Betrieb der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage.

Über uns

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders - und besser - gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

- Lesen und Interpretieren von Stromlauf-, Schalt- und Verdrahtungsplänen.

- Mitarbeit bei der Inbetriebnahme und Weiterentwicklung unserer Gebäudeautomation (FMCS), einschließlich Steuerungs- und Visualisierungssystemen.

- Koordination und Unterstützung externer Elektrofachfirmen sowie Sicherstellung einer fachgerechten und sicheren Ausführung.

- Gute Kenntnisse in der Elektrotechnik und Freude an praktischer Fehlersuche und Problemlösung.

- Sicherer Umgang mit Stromlauf- und Schaltplänen.

- Grundkenntnisse der relevanten elektrotechnischen Vorschriften und Sicherheitsbestimmungen.

- Eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team.

- Sehr Gute Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

title: Senior Site Reliaiblity Engineer
description:
Overview
Define what reliability means for a GPU-accelerated AI platform and make it measurable. You will own the service-level indicators and objectives for the K0rdent Observability Framework (KOF) - deriving meaningful SLIs from the signals the platform already emits, and exposing them to Platform Administrators through a clean API. Work spans hybrid, edge, and air-gapped deployments built on the Mirantis K0rdent stack.
About the Role
We are looking for a senior SRE who thinks past dashboards to the contract between a platform and its operators. The right candidate can look at raw telemetry from Kubernetes, bare metal, and NVIDIA infrastructure, decide which signals actually predict user-visible reliability, and turn them into SLIs and SLOs that operators can act on. You are equally comfortable writing the service that exposes those SLIs through an API and reasoning about error budgets, alerting quality, and signal-to-noise. You should be self-directed, able to own reliability definitions end to end, and effectively communicate them across teams.
Responsibilities

• Define SLIs and SLOs based on the signals available across the platform - Kubernetes, bare-metal hosts, and NVIDIA infrastructure (BMC, InfiniBand, NVLink, UFM).

• Design and build the API that exposes SLIs and reliability state to Platform Administrators and downstream systems.

• Establish alerting and error-budget practices that maximize signal and minimize noise.

• Partner with infrastructure, storage, and networking teams to ensure the right signals are instrumented and collected.

• Diagnose reliability and performance issues across the observability stack and drive their resolution.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years in SRE, platform reliability, or a closely related software/infrastructure role.

• Strong software engineering skills (e.g., Go or Python) with experience building and operating APIs or services in production.

• Demonstrated experience defining SLIs/SLOs and error budgets for real production systems.

• Hands-on experience with observability tooling - metrics, logging, and tracing (e.g., Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry, Grafana).

• Solid understanding of Kubernetes and the signals it and its workloads emit.

• Strong written and verbal communication with technical audiences.

Preferred

• Experience instrumenting or monitoring bare-metal and NVIDIA infrastructure (BMC/Redfish, InfiniBand, NVLink, UFM).

• Experience with the Mirantis K0rdent stack (K0rdent Enterprise, K0rdent AI, KOF) and Cluster API.

• Familiarity with VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs at scale.

• Proven experience in sovereign or high-security air-gapped environments.

Why you’ll love Mirantis

• Build the observability foundation for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI-first enterprises

• Collaborate with a world-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence

• Shape the product narrative and influence go-to-market success

description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.
GET TO KNOW US
At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep-all in one simple subscription. THE OPPORTUNITY
We are hiring a Senior SEC Reporting & Consolidations Specialist to our Finance team in the United States !
Reporting to the Corporate Controller and working closely with our external reporting team, this person will lead the use of AI and automation across our accounting and reporting processes, redesigning how we close, consolidate, report, and document so the work is faster, more automated, and well controlled. A key focus will be supporting the preparation of our quarterly and annual external financial statements and disclosures. The role also supports technical accounting and SOX compliance and owns our global financial consolidation. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.
YOUR IMPACT

•
Execute Consolidations: Run the monthly, quarterly, and annual global consolidation process across a multinational, multicurrency entity structure, including intercompany eliminations and ASC 842 lease accounting.

•
Prepare SEC Filings: Drive the preparation of quarterly and annual financial statements and SEC footnote disclosures (10-K, 10-Q), maintaining supporting schedules and disclosure checklists.

Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

•
SEC Reporting (Mandatory): 6+ years of accounting experience with direct, hands-on preparation of SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q) and footnote disclosures for a public company.

•
AI Builder (Mandatory): You are a hands-on builder of AI workflows, not just a casual prompt user. You must be able to walk us through concrete technical examples or code where you fully automated a manual accounting process.

•
Consolidations Expert: Deep, hands-on experience with financial consolidations in a multinational, multicurrency environment.

•
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA preferred. Big 4 public accounting experience is a strong plus.

•
Tech Stack: Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP. Experience with Pigment, Workiva/ActiveDisclosure, SQL, or Python is a plus.

title: Head of Go-To-Market
description:
Location
Remote in Europe or the US (New York, London, or Zurich). Travels more than 50%. Reports to the CEO.
About Albatross
Albatross builds perception models: AI that understands human behavior and powers product discovery the way a great salesperson does, by observing the customer and adapting in real time. LLMs understand words. We understand behavior.
Our models power discovery for 50 million+ shoppers a month. The results are public. Wallapop: +119% homepage engagement, +35% overall engagement. OfferUp: +84% homepage engagement, +20% overall engagement.
One platform, four primitives: discovery feed, similar items, playlist, contextual search. A customer goes live in seven weeks. The pipeline is global. We are deployed in 12 countries.
About the Job
The product is proven. Your job is to build the machine that sells it. You take the company from $10 million to $100 million: you close the revenue, and you build the organization that closes it after you.
We want a doer, not just a manager. We want someone who loves to build, not just run. We want someone who wants to join us on our path to building one of the most important layers of the internet.
You own new business, the pipeline, the revenue forecast and the go-to-market team. Today the CEO carries the pipeline. He will hand it to you.

• Close new enterprise deals yourself: marketplaces, classifieds, e-commerce, retail, media.

• Own the pipeline and the revenue forecast, and present them to the CEO

• Hire, ramp and lead sellers in Europe, the US, and Asia. Two Sales Directors join your team on day one.

• Define the go-to-market for our four primitives and for the self-serve platform that opens in 2027, and shape the products that follow.

Requirements

Who you are

• You have done this before: you were in the GTM seat when a company went from under $10M to $100M in ARR, and you closed a lot of it yourself. If it took you two years at an AI company, even better.

• You know what slows down at $10M, $20M, and $50M, and know how to fix it.

• You have built sales teams across several geographies and time zones. The first deals here are yours to close.

• You have sold APIs, infrastructure, or software to e-commerce. You know the decision makers in these companies, understand how they make money, and what they care about.

• You are technical enough to sell with our scientists. Our buyers are CPOs, VPs of Data and VPs of Engineering, and they will test you. You want to be at the forefront of AI, not just a user of it.

• You like to travel. Velocity is key, and human contact is irreplaceable.

• You are eligible to work in Europe or the US.

There is no playbook. You will write it!
What success looks like
3 months:

• You have met every live customer and every active pilot, in person.

• The pipeline is yours. The CEO is no longer the first call.

• Your first 3 deals at signature.

• The first two sellers are hired.

12 months:

• New business closes without the CEO in the room.

• Your forecast goes to the board, and it holds.

• Sellers are hired, ramped and building pipeline.

• Your team has booked $20 million of new ARR.

Benefits

• Europe-based: total at target €300-350k (€180k-€200k gross base salary + €120k - €150k variable at target).

• USA-based: total at target $350-$450k ($200k-$250k gross base salary + $150k - $200k variable at target).

• Equity, four-year vesting, one-year cliff.

• Full remote flexibility across Europe and the US.

• More benefits will depend on the location.

title: AI Research Engineer
description:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking an AI Research Engineer to join the HAIL team. HAIL (HRT AI Labs) is the team at HRT responsible for developing and maintaining our most powerful models, which are used by our trading teams to drive a significant fraction of our trading. We are building and deploying "foundation models for markets", that ingest and train on vast amounts of market and “alternative” data (such as language) to make predictions about future market state.

As a research engineer on HAIL, you will have a general mandate to improve all aspects of large-scale model training, including but not limited to kernel development, training data loading, parallelism, networking, and fault-tolerance. You will work closely with our researchers to co-design and improve our models, and shape the research agenda.

We have multiple large, modern, and rapidly growing GPU clusters, and we maintain a very high GPU-to-researcher ratio. We are simultaneously pursuing multiple strategies and developing many model types with different purposes, and we are strongly incentivized to squeeze as much as we can out of our systems. Your work will be directly, clearly, and highly impactful on the business, and it will be challenging: this is a field with no easy or obvious solutions.

Qualifications

• Strong engineering skills, especially any of: CUDA/Triton/Pallas/CuTe DSL kernel development, lower-level PyTorch/JAX/XLA development, CUDA Graphs, FPGA/ASIC experience
